messages.subject: Error in Spatial Detection History
parts:
Hi all,

I am fairly new to R and very new to CamTrapR. I have gotten to the spatial detection history and am running into some issues that I do not know how to solve. 

Error in `.rowNamesDF<-`(x, value = value) :
  duplicate 'row.names' are not allowed
3: non-unique values when setting 'row.names': ‘Station A’, ‘Station B’, ‘Station E’

The RecordTableIndividual has rows that are all labeled the same because I want cameras to be independent since some stations have multiple cameras. 

attached is my code: 

rec.db.Tayra <- recordTableIndividual(inDir = "E:/Species_Organized/Tayra" ,
                                     IDfrom = "metadata",
                                     minDeltaTime = 15,
                                     deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
                                     hasStationFolders = TRUE,
                                     cameraID = "filename",
                                     camerasIndependent = TRUE,
                                     metadataIDTag = "Species",
                                     timeZone = "America/Lima")

sdh <- spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = rec.db.Tayra,
                               species = "Tayra",
                               output = "binary",
                               camOp = camop_problem,
                               CTtable = dat,
                               stationCol = "Station",
                               speciesCol = "Species",
                               Xcol = "Longitude.UTM",
                               Ycol = "Latitude.UTM",
                               individualCol = "Individual",
                               recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
                               recordDateTimeFormat = "ymd_HMS",
                               occasionLength = 1,
                               day1 = "survey",
                               includeEffort = TRUE,
                               timeZone = "America/Lima")

Any assistance you can provide would be greatly appreciated!

parts:
Hi,
how did you create the camera operation matrix? Specifically, the argument byCamera? It should be FALSE, see this thread.

The error message isn't useful to me either which may mean its something unforeseen. So if byCamera doesn't fix it, feel free to share a small data subset (via email if you wish) to reproduce the problem.
Thank you,
Jürgen
